passages.text:
Hi all
A couple quick updates regarding tomorrow's DRG/Anticorruption session. (Reminder, its tomorrow at 3:30 at the Westin
Gateway by the Ballston metro)
1) Presentation: We have trimmed the slides a bit to give the small groups a little more time. Peter, Johnny and
Shannon will sit on the stage. We have also cancelled the closing wrap up, so once small groups are done folks can just
depart. No need to return to plenary.
2) Small group Locations: Group 1 (Vera): Mis/dis/malinformation will be Salon 1; Group 2 (Melissa): Anticorruption will
be in Salon 2. Group 3 (Laura) will stay in the Plenary room.
3) Note takers: Plenary (Dani and Meral); Stephanie Molina (Mis/dis/malinformation); Abigail Bellows (Anticorruption);
Blair King (Politically Dynamic Environments)
4) Dueout: ES has asked that we draft up a list of key highlights for each of the small breakout groups to share to all
participants by 7pm (as attendees can't attend all the breakouts.) Full notes can be shared later.
I will go there around 2:30 just to make sure things are set up. Here is the Agenda
Let me know if you have any questions!
Meral
Meral Karan
Team Lead, Democratic Resilience and Innovation Team
Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
US Agency for International Development
